brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: 3 full bases at 0,0,0 / 0,1,0 / 1,0,0 in compact L-shape plus notch:0#-1,1#notch0 with stem hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf which is a notch drawer frame filling the empty position between 0,0,0 and 0,1,0 with integrated drawer.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform
requirements.evidence: Spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 level 0 (the only point where all three bases meet) variant mount with accessory platform-sm set via setSpikeAccessory.

finish.summary: Compact desk: 3-piece L creating a three-way corner, with a mount spike carrying small platform at that junction and a notch drawer frame providing the desk drawer. Build checks clear (meshClash clear, no errors).

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
